status: amendment — supersedes wording only; no sealed artefact modified
original_wording: Traced directly to verify_answer() in api/answer_verification.py, live in production. Real thresholds (min_score=50, pass_threshold=80) and fail-safe passthrough behaviour confirmed against the source code.
finding: The phrase 'fail-safe passthrough' is inaccurate and misleading in the safety direction. verify_answer() fails OPEN, not safe: on any internal failure (missing API key, transport error, malformed verifier output, timeout) it returns the unmodified answer. A reader of a control described as a 'hallucination gate' would reasonably infer that the system abstains when it cannot verify. It does not — it answers. Until 12 Aug 2026 the resulting record was also INDISTINGUISHABLE from a record produced by a successful check, so a reply nobody verified could not be told apart from a verified one after the fact.

behaviour_before_amendment.on_verifier_failure: answer returned unchanged; verified=False; no state field
behaviour_before_amendment.record_written: none — api/calibrated_claims.py returned early and persisted nothing
behaviour_before_amendment.consequence: absence of a check left no trace; silence was indistinguishable from a pass

states.failed_grounding: check ran; answer not supported (abstain path)
states.not_checked: check did not run — DEFAULT, so the honest state is assumed rather than the flattering one

behaviour_after_code_change.record_written: a signed record is now persisted even when the check did not run (claim_record_id 'tbn_claim_unchecked_...', state 'not_checked', with not_checked_reason), so the absence of a check is itself evidence
behaviour_after_code_change.fail_direction_unchanged: the system still ANSWERS rather than abstaining when the verifier is unavailable; what changed is that this is now recorded and visible. Callers may opt into refusing to answer (see HBC_G6_REQUIRED in the heathrowblackcabs agent) but that is a per-product decision, not core behaviour.

corrected_wording_for_future_packages: Traced directly to verify_answer() in api/answer_verification.py, live in production. Real thresholds (min_score=50, pass_threshold=80) confirmed against the source code. The gate FAILS OPEN: if verification cannot be completed the answer is returned unverified rather than withheld. Such turns are recorded with an explicit state of 'not_checked' and a stated reason, and are distinguishable from verified turns in the signed record. Abstention occurs only when a check RUNS and the grounding score falls below min_score.

code_changes.change: added explicit 'state' to every return; pass-through now state='not_checked'
no longer returns without writing when unverified; persists a signed not_checked record via _record_not_checked(); state added to summaries

provenance_of_finding: Identified 11-12 Aug 2026 while wiring G6 into a new customer agent, and sharpened by a defect-register exchange with Shango (Ishaan Ghosh) which adopted the same three-state schema for attribution on the same day. The generalised statement of the defect class, from that exchange: the failure is not that unchecked items exist, but that silence converts them into settled ones with nothing recording the conversion.
